verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an inference API provider, so bulk operations such as a batch API across many requests are a fair axis for it. The evidence documents only single-request chat, responses, speech-to-text and document-extraction endpoints. Nothing in the pack describes a batch or bulk-processing capability, and the mention of per-model service tiers is too vague to count as one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
